summary_1line: Enraged by his champions’ deaths, Ravana orders Maharaksha to march out with his army to kill Rama and Lakshmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, blazing with rage in his palace, commands the large‑eyed warrior Maharaksha to go forth and slay Rama and Lakshmana.
Maharaksha ceremonially circles his chariot, salutes it, and orders his charioteer to drive as demon soldiers gather around.
Standing in his chariot before assembled rakshasa troops, Maharaksha boasts that he will destroy Rama, Lakshmana, and the monkey host with his weapons.
